_about.chapter: Vehicles and traffic: the car brands and models, BlackMark's factory look, the Zib cabs and where they go, how traffic treats people in the road, and the driving feel every car shares.
_about.how_to_edit: Plain JSON, inlined by tools/build.mjs as GAME_DB.vehicles and checked by tools/test-game-db.cjs. Speeds are px a tick (60 ticks a second), accelerations px a tick², times in ticks unless a name says ms, distances px, angles radians. Keys in camelCase or UPPER_SNAKE are read by the code under those names. Brand and model keys are in save files: never rename one. _about.fields explains each field of the tuning tables.

tables.brands: The three car brands (VEHICLE_BRANDS, traffic/garage-zib.js), each with its tier, baseStats (traffic's top speed, pull, grip and brake; seats; mass), drive (how it handles with the player at the wheel, see _about.fields.drive_feel), colors (traffic paint, the first is the showroom's), glowColor (null: no underglow), headlightColor, visualStyle, and its models. A model has a name, length and width in px, speedMod (× the brand's top speed in traffic), driven { top, accel } (how it goes when she drives it), optional seats and noHearseCap, and spec (its blueprint ratings out of 100, in the order of spec_labels). The brands differ in character, not in being worth driving: no car falls under about 80% of the best top speed or 60% of the best pull. LADY: the fastest, a heavy grand tourer with the best brakes. Zenxera: the quickest off the line (the Bolt), sharpest turn-in, lively tail. Gelfash: friendly and forgiving.
tables.spec_labels: The names of a model's five spec ratings (CAR_SPEC_LABELS). Lady's own sheet for the BlackMark V1 (100, 80, 80, 90, 100) set the scale; the rest are rated against it.
tables.blackmark_defaults: The BlackMark V1's factory look (BLACKMARK_DEFAULTS), restored by Reset to default. It is Stella's car and can't be sold.
tables.zib: The Zib cabs (ZIB_CONFIG): which car, its paint, underglow and headlights; the fare (fareBase + distance × farePerUnit, never under fareBase; hijacking is free); at most maxActive on the road, each tick a spawnChance of one more.
tables.zib_destinations: The order and labels of Zib's destinations on the phone (ZIB_DESTINATIONS, read by zibDestinations in traffic/garage-zib.js): id, the label, and the landmark it drives to. The list itself is every city building you can go to (worldQuery.getBuildings): these come first, in this order and under these labels; any building not listed follows under its own name; hide: true leaves one off.
tables.traffic_tempers: How traffic treats people in the road (TRAFFIC_TEMPERS, traffic/traffic-people.js): calm (and anyone driving for her), normal, and pushy (the gangers' cars). See _about.fields.traffic_tempers.
tables.traffic_ai: Traffic's driving and collisions (CONFIG.VEHICLE_AI): slowing for turns, where cars spawn, and how they bounce off walls. See _about.fields.traffic_ai.
tables.traffic_flow: How the street fills and empties (CONFIG.TRAFFIC_FLOW, traffic/traffic-manager.js): spawning out of sight, despawning at dead ends, far away or stuck out of view, fading in and out, the cap trim, and the sparks, debris and crunch of car-to-car hits. See _about.fields.traffic_flow.
tables.traffic_signals: Junction lights, gauged by demand (SIGNAL, traffic/traffic-signals.js): how long greens, ambers, all-reds, turn arrows and walk phases run, how far out cars are seen, and when turn paths count as crossing. See _about.fields.traffic_signals.
tables.traffic_runner: Lane runners (CONFIG.TRAFFIC_RUNNER, traffic/lane-runner.js): ordinary traffic runs along its lane or turn instead of driving its tyres, and hands itself to the full driver whenever something touches it or is in its way. See _about.fields.traffic_runner.
tables.drive: The driving feel every car shares (CONFIG.VEHICLE_DRIVE): steering curve, grip, the weight of the wheel, pedals and body, the handbrake, the camera, and the rigid body. A car's own numbers are in brands. See _about.fields.drive.
tables.mission_vehicles: Mission vehicle presets and authored local spawn offsets. amber_delivery defines the cafe delivery van.
tables.seating: Normalized cabin seat layout and exit clearance, resolved once per model by Directory. Explicit model seat_layout data can override it.

drive_feel.steerRate: How fast the wheel turns to the stick
drive_feel.turnIn: How hard the front tyres bite into a turn
drive_feel.gripR: Rear grip (lower: the tail steps out)
drive_feel.weight: How slowly the load shifts under braking and throttle

traffic_tempers.gap: Stop this far short of someone crossing
traffic_tempers.pull: Room to pull out round someone standing
traffic_tempers.swing: × the sideways shift it needs, in room to pull out (how sharply it pulls round)
traffic_tempers.rehonk: Sound it again every this many ticks (0: once)
traffic_tempers.pass: × the speed it goes by people at
traffic_tempers.kerb: Ticks before squeezing by on the far side
traffic_tempers.backUp: Ticks stuck before backing up to try again
traffic_tempers.take: × the gap it wants to pull into a moving lane, or to turn left across (traffic-signals.js)
traffic_tempers.amber: The share of its full brake it'll use to stop for an amber light

traffic_ai.TURN_SPEED_SHARP: maxSpeed × this for turns of 90° or more
traffic_ai.INTERSECTION_APPROACH_SLOWDOWN: Start slowing this far before a stop
traffic_ai.WALL_BOUNCE_FACTOR: Velocity × this on the axis that hit a wall
traffic_ai.SPAWN_CLEAR_MIN: Spawn traffic at least this far from her
traffic_ai.WALL_SLIDE_FRICTION: Speed kept along a wall (a glancing hit scrapes along it instead of stopping dead)
traffic_ai.WALL_MU: Friction along a wall at the point of contact (shapeKit.impulseAt)
traffic_ai.WALL_PUSHOUT: Separation nudge, in units of the speed after the hit

traffic_flow.SPAWN_EVERY: Ticks between spawn attempts while the street is under its cap
traffic_flow.SPAWN_TRIES_HIDDEN: Of those, how many must place the car out of view (the last tries take what they can; the fade hides it)
traffic_flow.SPAWN_VIEW_MARGIN: px past the screen's edge that still counts as in view, for spawning
traffic_flow.SPAWN_LANE_HALF_WIDTH: px either side of a lane's line within which another car is in that lane, for the spawn's clearance
traffic_flow.SPAWN_LANE_MARGIN: px of extra room ahead of and behind a new car
traffic_flow.SPAWN_ALONG_LENGTHS: A new car starts this many of its lengths into its lane
traffic_flow.SPAWN_END_LENGTHS: ...and never closer than this many lengths to the lane's end
traffic_flow.LANES_NEAR_SLACK: px of slack round the spawn ring when listing the lanes near her
traffic_flow.LANES_NEAR_RELIST: px she moves before that list is made again
traffic_flow.DEAD_END_DESPAWN: px short of a dead-end lane's end at which a car leaves
traffic_flow.FROZEN_SPEED: Below this speed (px/tick) a car counts as stopped, for gridlock relief
traffic_flow.FROZEN_TICKS: Ticks stopped before a car out of her way quietly leaves
traffic_flow.FROZEN_MIN_DIST: ...but only this far (px) or more from her
traffic_flow.FADE_OUT_TICKS: Ticks a leaving car takes to fade out
traffic_flow.FADE_IN_TICKS: Ticks a new car takes to fade in
traffic_flow.DESPAWN_HARD_EXTRA: px past CULLING.VEHICLE_DESPAWN at which a fading car goes at once
traffic_flow.TRIM_EVERY: Ticks between checks that the street is under its cap (the setting turned down)
traffic_flow.CRUNCH_COOLDOWN: Ticks between two traffic crunch sounds
traffic_flow.SPARK_MIN_HIT: Hit strength (px/tick of closing speed) that throws sparks
traffic_flow.DEBRIS_MIN_HIT: Hit strength that leaves glass and paint on the road
traffic_flow.CRUNCH_HEAR: px from her within which a traffic crunch is heard
traffic_flow.CRUNCH_FADE: px at which that crunch would fade to nothing
traffic_flow.FOLK_MIN_RADIUS: The smallest body on foot the cars size their search by (px)
traffic_flow.FOLK_JUMP: A move bigger than this (px in a tick) is a jump (a door, a load), not walking

traffic_signals.ON: Lights at every crossing of two roads (false: the old one-at-a-time queue)
traffic_signals.SEE: How far out a car on its way in shows on the gauge (px to the box)
traffic_signals.MIN_GREEN: Ticks a green runs at least, once someone waits on the other road
traffic_signals.MAX_GREEN: ...and at most, plus GREEN_PER for each unit of its own demand, up to MAX_BUSY
traffic_signals.GREEN_PER: Extra green ticks per unit of demand
traffic_signals.MAX_BUSY: The longest a busy green runs
traffic_signals.STARVED: Ticks a car may wait on red before its road's turn comes straight after MIN_GREEN
traffic_signals.WALK: Ticks from the start of a green that walkers may start across the red road, whatever's waiting
traffic_signals.CLEAR_WALK: Ticks the all-red waits for walkers still crossing (after that, the cars wait for them)
traffic_signals.STOP_BACK: The stop line, px short of the box (behind the crosswalk)
traffic_signals.CROSS: Two turn paths closer than this anywhere (centre to centre, px) cross, plus each one's DRIFT
traffic_signals.DRIFT: How far cars stray off a turn path mid-way (px): straight on, and turning
traffic_signals.YIELD: Ticks of oncoming arrival a left turn won't cut across (× the temper's take)
traffic_signals.ARROW: A turn arrow ahead of a green for cars waiting to turn (false: turns only on the green)
traffic_signals.ARROW_MIN: Ticks a turn arrow runs at least
traffic_signals.ARROW_MAX: ...and at most (it ends early once the turners are through)
traffic_signals.TURN_AT: A car waiting to turn this close (centre, px to the box) asks for the arrow
traffic_signals.TURN_STALL: Ticks a left turn may stand at the front of its lane on a green before it gets an arrow

traffic_runner.ON: Ordinary traffic runs on rails (false: every car drives with the full driver, as before)
traffic_runner.CURVE_SAMPLES: Points a junction turn's curve is sampled into, once
traffic_runner.LOOK_BASE: px a runner looks ahead past its own length and stopping distance
traffic_runner.LOOK_PER_SPEED: ...plus this many px per px/tick of speed
traffic_runner.SLIDE_PER_ACC: The slide through a turn: sideways speed (px/tick) per unit of sideways pull (v² × bend)
traffic_runner.SLIDE_EASE: How quickly the slide builds and fades (share a tick)
traffic_runner.SLIP_MAX: The most the nose turns in for it (sine of the angle)
traffic_runner.JOIN_LAT: A car back from the full driver joins the rails within this many px of its lane's line
traffic_runner.JOIN_ANGLE: ...and lined up with it within this many radians
traffic_runner.CALM_TICKS: ...after this many ticks of both, with nothing in its way
traffic_runner.STUCK_TICKS: Ticks stopped behind a car that isn't moving before the full driver takes over (to go round)
traffic_runner.FOLK_MARGIN: px of room past a person's radius and the car's half width that counts as in the way

drive.REVERSE_TOP_FRACTION: Reverse tops out at this × forward maxSpeed (drag comes from each car's maxSpeed and acceleration, so it tops out at its stat)
drive.STEER_RAMP_SPEED: Speed at which the wheel has full authority
drive.STEER_MIN_SPEED: Below this the wheel does nothing
drive.STEER_HIGH_FLOOR: Steering kept at very high speed
drive.STEER_FALLOFF: How quickly steering eases off past the ramp speed
drive.GRIP_BASE: Share of sideways speed kept per tick
drive.GRIP_RAIN_PENALTY: Taken off grip in full rain
drive.GRIP_SLIDE_THRESHOLD: Sideways speed at which grip starts to break away
drive.DEFAULT_FEEL: A car's drive feel when its brand gives none (fields as in drive_feel)
drive.CENTER_RATE: The wheel self-centres this share of what's left each tick…
drive.CENTER_RATE_SPEED: …plus this per px/tick of speed (caster), up to…
drive.AI_STEER_RATE: Traffic's drawn wheels (their steering itself is direct)
drive.PEDAL_IN: Throttle travel per tick (about 0.2 s to the floor)
drive.PEDAL_OUT: Pedal travel per tick when lifting off
drive.LOAD_FWD_GRIP: Front grip gained per unit of forward load…
drive.LOAD_RATE: How fast the load shifts (÷ the brand's weight)
drive.HANDBRAKE_REAR_GRIP: Rear grip with the handbrake up
drive.HANDBRAKE_DECEL: Speed scrubbed per tick by locked rear wheels
drive.POWER_OVERSTEER: Rear grip lost to full throttle at full lock (0: steering alone never kicks the tail out)
drive.HANDBRAKE_YAW_DAMP: Rotation kept per tick with the handbrake up (lower: less swing)
drive.REVERSE_BELOW: Pulling back only reverses under this speed
drive.CAM_LOOK_AHEAD: The camera leads by velocity × PER_SPEED, easing over TAU_MS (engine/draw.js)
drive.CAM_ZOOM: Zoom = 1 − speed share × SPAN, never below FLOOR (× 0.9 in landscape)
drive.STICK_YAW_DAMP: Precise Stick: how hard rotation is damped
drive.STICK_LIGHT_LOCK: Precise Stick: wheel lock at the lightest push…
drive.STICK_FULL_LOCK_PUSH: …growing to full lock by this shaped push (about two-thirds out)
drive.SPIN_INERTIA: × a plain box's inertia (m(L²+W²)/12): higher, a hit turns the car less
drive.YAW_SPIN_MAX: The fastest any car spins (rad a tick)
drive.AXLE_FROM_CENTRE: Each axle sits this × length ahead of or behind the centre
drive.TYRE_STIFF: Share of an axle's sideways slide its tyres take out per tick (front × the brand's turnIn)
drive.KNOCK_MIN_HIT: Traffic on traffic: closing speed below this doesn't spin them
drive.KNOCK_SPIN_DECAY: Traffic: spin kept per tick after a knock
drive.PARKED_SCRUB: A shunted parked car: speed and spin kept per tick on locked wheels…
drive.PARKED_HOLD: …after this much speed is taken off first (a brush doesn't move it)
drive.COAST_DRAG: Extra off-throttle drag per unit of (1 − friction)
